idea: VocacionData AI: orientacion vocacional basada en datos laborales reales para postulantes y estudiantes peruanos, usando un agente conversacional que cruza intereses, salarios, empleabilidad, oferta universitaria y ubicacion para reducir malas decisiones de carrera.

selected_gap.title: Real-time labor data integration for career matching
selected_gap.pain: Students choose careers without knowing actual salaries, employability, or demand in Peru, leading to high mismatch and unemployment.
selected_gap.why_now: No existing tool combines psychometric tests with live labor market data; government portals are static and hard to use.
selected_gap.evidence_needed: Survey showing >70% of students lack labor market info; pilot with 100 students measuring decision confidence.
selected_gap.risk: Data acquisition and maintenance costs; need partnerships with government and universities.

decision: No-go currently; needs founder-market fit and monetization validation.
next_experiments: Survey 100 students to quantify willingness to pay and level of pain
Interview university career counselors to understand workflow and trust barriers
Build an MVP using mock labor data and test with 30 students measuring decision confidence change
Explore partnerships with government labor agencies for data access
kill_criteria: Less than 50% of students willing to pay any amount (even subsidized)
Unable to secure a single data partnership or compelling data proxy within 3 months
Pilot shows no significant improvement in decision confidence vs. baseline
Burnout or founder disinterest after 2 months of customer development
